mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 2.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 250.0 signals elevated inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 250.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising labor force (PAYEMS increase) signals strong economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.0%, PAYEMS growth fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 107.0) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 107.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 growth > 0.5%) indicates strong economic expansion, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains stagnant or falls, it signals inadequate monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising CPIAUCSL and stagnant/falling FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC is positive over any 3-year rolling window.
